faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a yacht charter in Marbella in 2032?
faq.a: The maximum is 12 passengers on most of our larger yachts, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94. Smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 carry up to 9, while speedboats such as the Dubhe accommodate up to 5. Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking.

faq.q: Can I charter a boat for a group of 15 people in Marbella?
faq.a: No, our fleet is limited to 12 passengers maximum per boat due to safety regulations and insurance requirements. For larger groups, we recommend booking two boats simultaneously, such as two Mangusta 80s, which can accommodate up to 24 guests in total.

faq.q: Do children count towards the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes, all passengers, including infants and children, count towards the maximum capacity. The limits are set by the boat's safety certification and life raft capacity. Please include all guests when booking to ensure compliance and safety.

faq.q: Which Marbella yacht charter boats can accommodate 12 passengers?
faq.a: Several of our yachts carry up to 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (white and grey), Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, Maiora 26m, and Mangusta 80. These are ideal for larger groups wanting a full-day charter from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is the smallest boat available for a group charter?
faq.a: The smallest boats are the Dubhe (8m, 5 passengers) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 passengers). Both are speedboats perfect for small families or couples wanting a quick trip along the Marbella coastline.

faq.q: Are there any extra charges for exceeding the group size limit?
faq.a: We strictly enforce the maximum passenger limits for safety and legal reasons. Exceeding the limit is not permitted. If you need to accommodate more guests, consider booking a larger boat or a second vessel. Contact us for advice on the best configuration.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht charter for my group size?
faq.a: Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll match you with the best boat from our fleet. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, departing from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the price for a group charter?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours.

data.body_html:
Planning a yacht charter in Marbella for 2032? One of the first questions you need to answer is how many guests you can bring. Group size limits vary by boat, and knowing them upfront saves time and ensures a smooth booking. In this guide, we break down the maximum passenger capacities for our entire fleet, from intimate speedboats to spacious superyachts, all departing from Puerto Banús.

Why Group Size Limits Matter

Safety regulations and insurance policies set strict passenger limits on every charter vessel. These limits are based on life raft capacity, stability calculations, and emergency procedures. Exceeding them is both illegal and dangerous. For your peace of mind, all our boats are certified for a specific number of passengers, and we never exceed these caps.

Our fleet offers a range of capacities to suit different group sizes. Here's a clear breakdown:

Choosing the Right Boat for Your Group

For small groups of up to 5, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 speedboats are perfect for a quick coastal dash to Cala del Faro or Cabopino. Groups of 6–8 will enjoy the Red Tide or Bandido. Larger parties of 9–11 should consider the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, both Tier A boats with all-inclusive pricing from €749 for 2 hours. For the full 12-person experience, the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 offer luxury and space for a day trip to Estepona or Sotogrande.

What If My Group Is Larger Than 12?

If you have more than 12 guests, we recommend chartering two boats simultaneously. For example, two Mangusta 80s can accommodate up to 24 passengers. This also allows your group to spread out and enjoy different experiences while staying together. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss multi-boat options.

Pricing Overview for Group Charters

Pricing depends on the boat and duration. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are the most affordable: €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. These prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. For all other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the maximum group size for a yacht charter in Marbella in 2032?

The maximum is 12 passengers on most of our larger yachts, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, and Ferretti 94. Smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 carry up to 9, while speedboats such as the Dubhe accommodate up to 5. Always check the specific boat's capacity before booking.

Can I charter a boat for a group of 15 people in Marbella?

No, our fleet is limited to 12 passengers maximum per boat due to safety regulations and insurance requirements. For larger groups, we recommend booking two boats simultaneously, such as two Mangusta 80s, which can accommodate up to 24 guests in total.

Do children count towards the passenger limit?

Yes, all passengers, including infants and children, count towards the maximum capacity. The limits are set by the boat's safety certification and life raft capacity. Please include all guests when booking to ensure compliance and safety.

Which Marbella yacht charter boats can accommodate 12 passengers?

Several of our yachts carry up to 12 passengers: Mangusta 80 (white and grey), Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, Maiora 26m, and Mangusta 80. These are ideal for larger groups wanting a full-day charter from Puerto Banús.

What is the smallest boat available for a group charter?

The smallest boats are the Dubhe (8m, 5 passengers) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 passengers). Both are speedboats perfect for small families or couples wanting a quick trip along the Marbella coastline.

Are there any extra charges for exceeding the group size limit?

We strictly enforce the maximum passenger limits for safety and legal reasons. Exceeding the limit is not permitted. If you need to accommodate more guests, consider booking a larger boat or a second vessel. Contact us for advice on the best configuration.

How do I book a yacht charter for my group size?

Simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll match you with the best boat from our fleet. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks, departing from Puerto Banús.

What is included in the price for a group charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours.
